card.line: Judea was the southernmost region of Palestine in Jesus' day, where Jesus was born, John preached in the wilderness, and the church was first scattered.

moments.title: Jesus born in Judea
moments.text: Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea during the time of King Herod. Magi from the east came to Jerusalem asking where the newborn King of the Jews was.

moments.title: John preaches in the wilderness
moments.text: John the Baptist preached in the wilderness of Judea, telling people to repent. People from Jerusalem and all Judea went out to him and were baptized in the Jordan River.

moments.title: Jesus baptizes in the countryside
moments.text: Jesus and His disciples went into the Judean countryside. He spent some time with them there and baptized.

moments.title: Jesus warns people in Judea to flee
moments.text: Jesus said that when Jerusalem was surrounded by armies, those in Judea should flee to the mountains.

moments.title: The church is scattered
moments.text: After Stephen's death, a great persecution broke out in Jerusalem. All except the apostles were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria, and they preached the word wherever they went.
